notes.title: Dark Gravity Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Fans,

Patch 1.01 has just been released, here you can see a list of all the fixes implemented, based on your feedback. Thanks for playing our game and we hope you will continue enjoying it.

What has been fixed:

 Scrolling script on missions (sometimes camera was stopping at incorrect positions making missions impossible to finish)
 Aoe slowing and jamming attacks were affecting player incorrectly
 Archalien boss had wrong collision setup
 Fossil boss laser rotating attack had too high speed
 Deselecting additional weapons in hangar by removing weapon slot upgrade was not removing weapon model from the fighter (bug not affecting gameplay and occuring only in menu)



Best,
GamePlanet
